newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Sluggish Slovak SAX eases on Slovnaft fall.
newsitem.headline: Sluggish Slovak SAX eases on Slovnaft fall.

text.p: Trade on Slovakia's Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) remained sluggish on Wednesday, with the official SAX index easing 0.99 points to 167.76, pulled down by oil refiner Slovnaft.
Slovnaft, the most heavily-weighted issue in the index, closed down 10 crowns at 830, with only 27 shares traded.
A new division of the market into three sections, effective since August 1 and expected by brokers to increase trading transparency, has still failed to raise liquidity on the automated system.
Only some 8,000 shares were matched on the listed, registered and free floors, while more than 800,000 changed hands in direct trading.
Steel maker VSZ, the most liquid first-tier issue, traded 419 shares, closing down 10 crowns at 640.
Overall, volume increased to 835,043 shares, from 507,672 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover rose to 318.76 million crowns, from 284.1 million.
